ROOT.scriptdef: if exists (select * from dbo.sysobjects where id = object_id(N'CDN.ESKLEP_EksportDaneBinarne') and OBJECTPROPERTY(id, N'IsProcedure') = 1) drop procedure CDN.ESKLEP_EksportDaneBinarne

CREATE PROCEDURE [CDN].[ESKLEP_EksportDaneBinarne] @ID INT -- ID e-sklepu ,@TypExp INT -- Typ eksportu danych binarnych (0 - różnicowy, 1 - pełny) ,@DABID INT OUTPUT -- ID danych binarnych, które zostały jako ostatnie wyeksportowane do e-sklepu w poprzedniej paczce -- Jeżeli @DABID = -1 to w OUTPUT zwracany jest DAB_DABID danych binarnych wyeksportowanych jako ostatnie w poprzedniej paczce AS SET NOCOUNT ON
IF @DABID = -1 BEGIN SELECT @DABID = PcK_Blokady FROM CDN.PicoKonfig WHERE PcK_PicoID = @ID RETURN END
DECLARE @Typ_GrT SMALLINT DECLARE @Typ_Twr SMALLINT SET @Typ_GrT = -16 SET @Typ_Twr = 16
DECLARE @Rozmiar BIGINT ,@RozmiarMax INT -- Maksymalny rozmiar danych binarnych eksportowanych w jednej paczce ,@Last_DABID INT ,@PCKTGGNumer INT
DECLARE @Table TABLE(DABID INT, DABRozmiar BIGINT)
SELECT @Rozmiar = 0 ,@RozmiarMax = 10485760 -- 10MB --,@RozmiarMax = 20971520 -- 20MB SELECT @PCKTGGNumer = TwG_GIDNumer FROM CDN.PicoKonfig (nolock) JOIN CDN.TwrGrupy (NOLOCK) ON TwG_SyncId = PcK_TwGNumer AND TwG_GIDTyp = -16 WHERE Pck_PicoId = @ID
INSERT INTO @Table
SELECT DISTINCT DAB_ID, ISNULL(DATALENGTH(DAB_Dane),0) FROM CDN.DaneBinarne JOIN CDN.Atrybuty ON Atr_AtrTyp = 14400 AND Atr_AtrNumer = DAB_ID JOIN CDN.AtrybutyKlasy ON AtK_ID = Atr_AtkId JOIN CDN.TwrKarty ON Twr_GIDNumer = Atr_ObiNumer AND Twr_GIDTyp = Atr_ObiTyp JOIN CDN.PicoKonfig ON Pck_PicoId = @ID LEFT OUTER JOIN CDN.PicoLog ON PcL_PcKID = Pck_PicoId AND PcL_ObiTyp = Twr_GIDTyp AND PcL_ObiNumer = Twr_GIDNumer WHERE AtK_eSklep = 1 AND Twr_eSklep = 1 AND Twr_Archiwalny = 0 AND DAB_ID > @DABID AND DAB_Dane IS NOT NULL AND Twr_GIDNumer > 0 AND EXISTS(SELECT TwL_GrONumer FROM CDN.TwrLinki WHERE Twr_GIDTyp = TwL_GIDTyp AND Twr_GIDNumer = TwL_GIDNumer AND TwL_GrONumer = @PCKTGGNumer ) AND (DAB_CzasModyfikacji > CASE WHEN @TypExp=0 THEN PcK_TSSynchrTwrPtw ELSE 0 END OR ISNULL(PcK_TSSynchrTwrPtw, PcL_TStamp) > PcK_TSSynchrTwrPtw )
UNION
SELECT DISTINCT DAB_ID, ISNULL(DATALENGTH(DAB_Dane),0) FROM CDN.DaneBinarne JOIN CDN.DaneObiekty ON DAO_DABId = DAB_ID JOIN CDN.TwrKarty ON Twr_GIDNumer = DAO_ObiNumer AND Twr_GIDTyp = DAO_ObiTyp JOIN CDN.PicoKonfig ON Pck_PicoId = @ID LEFT OUTER JOIN CDN.PicoLog ON PcL_PcKID = Pck_PicoId AND PcL_ObiTyp = Twr_GIDTyp AND PcL_ObiNumer = Twr_GIDNumer WHERE DAO_eSklep = 1 AND Twr_eSklep = 1 AND Twr_Archiwalny = 0 AND DAB_ID > @DABID AND DAB_Dane IS NOT NULL AND Twr_GIDNumer > 0 AND EXISTS(SELECT TwL_GrONumer FROM CDN.TwrLinki WHERE Twr_GIDTyp = TwL_GIDTyp AND Twr_GIDNumer = TwL_GIDNumer AND TwL_GrONumer = @PCKTGGNumer ) AND (DAB_CzasModyfikacji > CASE WHEN @TypExp=0 THEN PcK_TSSynchrTwrPtw ELSE 0 END OR ISNULL(PcK_TSSynchrTwrPtw, PcL_TStamp) > PcK_TSSynchrTwrPtw )
UNION
SELECT DISTINCT DAB_ID, ISNULL(DATALENGTH(DAB_Dane),0) FROM CDN.DaneBinarne JOIN CDN.AtrybutyHist ON AtH_AtrTyp = 14400 and AtH_AtrNumer = DAB_Id JOIN CDN.AtrybutyKlasy ON AtK_ID = AtH_AtkId JOIN CDN.TwrKarty ON Twr_GIDNumer = AtH_ObiNumer AND Twr_GIDTyp = AtH_ObiTyp JOIN CDN.PicoKonfig ON Pck_PicoId = @ID LEFT OUTER JOIN CDN.PicoLog ON PcL_PcKID = Pck_PicoId AND PcL_ObiTyp = Twr_GIDTyp AND PcL_ObiNumer = Twr_GIDNumer WHERE AtK_eSklep = 1 AND Twr_eSklep = 1 AND Twr_Archiwalny = 0 AND DAB_ID > @DABID AND DAB_Dane IS NOT NULL AND Twr_GIDNumer > 0 AND EXISTS(SELECT TwL_GrONumer FROM CDN.TwrLinki WHERE Twr_GIDTyp = TwL_GIDTyp AND Twr_GIDNumer = TwL_GIDNumer AND TwL_GrONumer = @PCKTGGNumer ) AND (DAB_CzasModyfikacji > CASE WHEN @TypExp=0 THEN PcK_TSSynchrTwrPtw ELSE 0 END OR ISNULL(PcK_TSSynchrTwrPtw, PcL_TStamp) > PcK_TSSynchrTwrPtw )
UNION
SELECT DISTINCT DAB_ID, ISNULL(DATALENGTH(DAB_Dane),0) FROM CDN.DaneBinarne JOIN CDN.DaneObiekty ON DAO_DABId = DAB_ID JOIN CDN.TwrGrupy ON Twg_GIDNumer = DAO_ObiNumer AND Twg_GIDTyp = DAO_ObiTyp JOIN CDN.PicoKonfig ON Pck_PicoId = @ID LEFT OUTER JOIN CDN.PicoLog ON PcL_PcKID = Pck_PicoId AND PcL_ObiTyp = Twg_GIDTyp AND PcL_ObiNumer = Twg_GIDNumer WHERE DAO_eSklep = 1 AND DAB_ID > @DABID AND DAB_Dane IS NOT NULL AND (DAB_CzasModyfikacji > CASE WHEN @TypExp=0 THEN PcK_TSSynchrTwrPtw ELSE 0 END OR ISNULL(PcK_TSSynchrTwrPtw, PcL_TStamp) > PcK_TSSynchrTwrPtw ) AND TwG_GIDTyp=@Typ_GrT AND (EXISTS(SELECT * FROM CDN.TwrGrupy WHERE TwG_GIDTyp = @Typ_GrT AND TwG_CzasModyfikacji > PcK_TSSynchrGrupPtw) OR @TypExp=1) AND (TwG_GIDNumer = @PCKTGGNumer OR TwG_GrONumer = @PCKTGGNumer OR EXISTS(SELECT * FROM CDN.TwrLinki WHERE TwL_GIDTyp = @Typ_GrT AND TwL_GIDNumer = TwG_GrONumer AND TwL_GrONumer = @PCKTGGNumer) )
UNION
SELECT DISTINCT DAB_ID, ISNULL(DATALENGTH(DAB_Dane),0) FROM CDN.DaneBinarne JOIN CDN.DaneObiekty ON DAO_DABId = DAB_Tlumaczenie JOIN CDN.TwrKarty ON Twr_GIDNumer = DAO_ObiNumer AND Twr_GIDTyp = DAO_ObiTyp JOIN CDN.PicoKonfig ON Pck_PicoId = @ID LEFT OUTER JOIN CDN.PicoLog ON PcL_PcKID = Pck_PicoId AND PcL_ObiTyp = Twr_GIDTyp AND PcL_ObiNumer = Twr_GIDNumer WHERE DAO_eSklep = 1 AND Twr_eSklep = 1 AND Twr_Archiwalny = 0 AND DAB_ID > @DABID AND DAB_Dane IS NOT NULL AND Twr_GIDNumer > 0 AND EXISTS(SELECT TwL_GrONumer FROM CDN.TwrLinki WHERE Twr_GIDTyp = TwL_GIDTyp AND Twr_GIDNumer = TwL_GIDNumer AND TwL_GrONumer = @PCKTGGNumer ) AND (DAB_CzasModyfikacji > CASE WHEN @TypExp=0 THEN PcK_TSSynchrTwrPtw ELSE 0 END OR ISNULL(PcK_TSSynchrTwrPtw, PcL_TStamp) > PcK_TSSynchrTwrPtw )
UNION
--Kontrahenci - do wysyłki logotypu producenta SELECT DISTINCT DAB_ID, ISNULL(DATALENGTH(DAB_Dane),0) FROM CDN.DaneBinarne JOIN CDN.DaneObiekty ON DAO_DABId = DAB_Tlumaczenie JOIN CDN.KntKarty ON Knt_GIDNumer = DAO_ObiNumer AND Knt_GIDTyp= DAO_ObiTyp JOIN CDN.PicoKonfig ON Pck_PicoId = @ID LEFT OUTER JOIN CDN.PicoLog ON PcL_PcKID = Pck_PicoId AND PcL_ObiTyp = Knt_GIDTyp AND PcL_ObiNumer = Knt_GIDNumer WHERE DAO_eSklep = 1 AND Knt_ESklep = 1 AND Knt_Archiwalny= 0 AND DAB_ID > @DABID AND DAB_Dane IS NOT NULL AND Knt_GIDNumer > 0 AND EXISTS(SELECT KnL_GrONumer FROM CDN.KntLinki WHERE Knt_GIDTyp = KnL_GIDTyp AND Knt_GIDNumer = KnL_GIDNumer) AND (DAB_CzasModyfikacji > CASE WHEN @TypExp=0 THEN PcK_TSSynchrTwrPtw ELSE 0 END OR ISNULL(PcK_TSSynchrTwrPtw, PcL_TStamp) > PcK_TSSynchrTwrPtw )
UNION
--Marki - do wysyłki logotypu SELECT DISTINCT DAB_ID, ISNULL(DATALENGTH(DAB_Dane),0) FROM CDN.DaneBinarne JOIN CDN.Slowniki MRK ON MRK.SLW_WartoscL1 = DAB_ID JOIN CDN.TwrKarty ON Twr_MarkaId = SLW_ID JOIN CDN.PicoKonfig ON Pck_PicoId = @ID LEFT OUTER JOIN CDN.PicoLog ON PcL_PcKID = Pck_PicoId AND PcL_ObiTyp = Twr_GIDTyp AND PcL_ObiNumer = Twr_GIDNumer WHERE DAB_eSklep = 1 AND Twr_eSklep = 1 AND Twr_Archiwalny = 0 AND DAB_ID > @DABID AND DAB_Dane IS NOT NULL AND Twr_GIDNumer > 0 AND EXISTS(SELECT TwL_GrONumer FROM CDN.TwrLinki WHERE Twr_GIDTyp = TwL_GIDTyp AND Twr_GIDNumer = TwL_GIDNumer AND TwL_GrONumer = @PCKTGGNumer ) AND (DAB_CzasModyfikacji > CASE WHEN @TypExp=0 THEN PcK_TSSynchrTwrPtw ELSE 0 END OR ISNULL(PcK_TSSynchrTwrPtw, PcL_TStamp) > PcK_TSSynchrTwrPtw )
ORDER BY DAB_ID
DELETE FROM @Table WHERE DABRozmiar > @RozmiarMax --Usuń załączniki większe niż cała paczka UPDATE @Table SET @Rozmiar = @Rozmiar + DABRozmiar, DABRozmiar = @Rozmiar SELECT @Last_DABID = MAX(DABID) FROM @Table WHERE DABRozmiar <= @RozmiarMax UPDATE CDN.PicoKonfig SET PcK_Blokady = (CASE WHEN @Last_DABID < (SELECT MAX(DABID) FROM @Table) THEN @Last_DABID ELSE 0 END) WHERE PcK_PicoID = @ID
SET NOCOUNT OFF
SELECT DAB_ID AS ID, CDN.XLValidateXMLChars(DAB_Nazwa) AS Nazwa, DAB_Rozszerzenie AS Rozszerzenie, DAB_Rozmiar AS Rozmiar, DAB_Dane AS Dane,DATALENGTH(DAB_Dane) AS Rozmiar2 FROM CDN.DaneBinarne AS DAB WHERE DAB_ID IN (SELECT DABID FROM @Table WHERE DABID <= @Last_DABID ) AND ISNULL(DATALENGTH(DAB_Dane),0) > 0 FOR XML AUTO,BINARY BASE64
DELETE FROM @Table
GRANT EXECUTE ON CDN.ESKLEP_EksportDaneBinarne TO CDNRaport
